openPoints: How will the browser limiter avoid accumulating overlapping presence.typing promises if the MCP endpoint remains slow or hung for minutes, even though request starts are bounded to one per 400 ms window?

Which integration-level test proves that connectOg itself—not only the isolated ConnectionOwner abstraction—ignores an out-of-order close callback and prevents signalTyping from reaching the replacement or closed handle?
How will production telemetry distinguish expected rate limiting from lost typing signals caused by repeated MCP rejection, disconnect churn, or a stale actor-session index?
architectureTip: Keep connection generation, bounded signaling, and actor-session indexing as explicit lifecycle boundaries, and add observability plus integration-level ownership checks around those boundaries.
topFinding: The retry closes the prior high-impact fabricated-session resource-exhaustion path and makes typing work proportional to the authenticated actor's live sessions; remaining risk is mainly missing backpressure and direct connectOg race coverage.
